      "formal_name": "Finset.pow_card_le_prod",
      "informal_name": "n^{\\#s} \\leq \\prod_{x \\in s} f(x)",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : CommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] [MulLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι)\n  (f : ι → N) (n : N), (∀ x ∈ s, n ≤ f x) → n ^ s.card ≤ s.prod f",
      "informal_description": "Let $ N $ be a commutative monoid equipped with a partial order where left multiplication is monotonic. For any finite set $ s $ of type $ \\iota $, a function $ f : \\iota \\to N $, and an element $ n \\in N $, if $ n \\leq f(x) $ for all $ x \\in s $, then $ n^{\\#s} \\leq \\prod_{x \\in s} f(x) $.",

      "formal_name": "Finset.prod_le_pow_card",
      "informal_name": "Product over Finset is at Most $n^{|s|}$",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : CommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] [MulLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι)\n  (f : ι → N) (n : N), (∀ x ∈ s, f x ≤ n) → s.prod f ≤ n ^ s.card",
      "informal_description": "In a commutative monoid $N$ where left multiplication is monotonic, for any finite set $s$ and function $f : \\iota \\to N$, if every element $f(x)$ for $x \\in s$ satisfies $f(x) \\leq n$, then the product of all $f(x)$ over $s$ is less than or equal to $n$ raised to the power of the cardinality of $s$, i.e., $\\prod_{x \\in s} f(x) \\leq n^{|s|}$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Algebra.Order.BigOperators.Group.Finset"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "List.prod_map_le_pow_length₀",
      "informal_name": "Product of Mapped List Elements is Bounded by r to the Power of List Length",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero R] [inst_1 : PartialOrder R] [ZeroLEOneClass R] [PosMulMono R]\n  {F : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} [inst_4 : FunLike F L R] {f : F} {r : R} {t : List L},\n  (∀ (x : L), x ∈ t → 0 ≤ f x) → (∀ (x : L), x ∈ t → f x ≤ r) → (List.map (⇑f) t).prod ≤ r ^ t.length",
      "informal_description": "For any ordered commutative monoid with zero $ R $ where multiplication is monotonic for non-negative elements, given a function $ f $ mapping elements of a list $ t $ to $ R $, if each $ f(x) $ is non-negative and satisfies $ f(x) \\leq r $ for some $ r \\in R $, then the product of the mapped elements satisfies $ \\prod_{x \\in t} f(x) \\leq r^{\\lvert t \\rvert} $, where $ \\lvert t \\rvert $ denotes the length of the list $ t $.",

      "formal_name": "Finset.apply_prod_le_sum_apply",

      "informal_description": "Let $\\alpha$ be a multiplicative monoid and $M$ an ordered additive commutative monoid. For any function $g : \\alpha \\to M$ satisfying $g(1) \\leq 0$ and $g(ab) \\leq g(a) + g(b)$ for all $a, b \\in \\alpha$, and for any finite set $s$ and function $f : s \\to \\alpha$, it holds that $g\\left(\\prod_{x \\in s} f(x)\\right) \\leq \\sum_{x \\in s} g(f(x))$.",

      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {M : Type u_3} [inst : Monoid M] [inst_1 : Preorder M] [MulRightMono M] [MulLeftMono M] (l : List M) (n : M),\n  (∀ (x : M), x ∈ l → n ≤ x) → n ^ l.length ≤ l.prod",

For any list $ l $ of elements in $ M $ and any element $ n \\in M $ such that $ n \\leq x $ for all $ x \\in l $, it holds that $ n^{|l|} \\leq \\prod_{x \\in l} x $, where $ |l| $ denotes the length of the list $ l $.",

items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : CommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] [MulLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → N) (n : N), (∀ x ∈ s, n ≤ f x) → n ^ s.card ≤ s.prod f
items.informal_description: Let $ N $ be a commutative monoid equipped with a partial order where left multiplication is monotonic. For any finite set $ s $ of type $ \iota $, a function $ f : \iota \to N $, and an element $ n \in N $, if $ n \leq f(x) $ for all $ x \in s $, then $ n^{\#s} \leq \prod_{x \in s} f(x) $.

items.informal_name: Product over Finset is at Most $n^{|s|}$
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : CommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] [MulLeftMono N] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → N) (n : N), (∀ x ∈ s, f x ≤ n) → s.prod f ≤ n ^ s.card
items.informal_description: In a commutative monoid $N$ where left multiplication is monotonic, for any finite set $s$ and function $f : \iota \to N$, if every element $f(x)$ for $x \in s$ satisfies $f(x) \leq n$, then the product of all $f(x)$ over $s$ is less than or equal to $n$ raised to the power of the cardinality of $s$, i.e., $\prod_{x \in s} f(x) \leq n^{|s|}$.

items.informal_name: Product of Mapped List Elements is Bounded by r to the Power of List Length
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoidWithZero R] [inst_1 : PartialOrder R] [ZeroLEOneClass R] [PosMulMono R]
  {F : Type u_2} {L : Type u_3} [inst_4 : FunLike F L R] {f : F} {r : R} {t : List L},
  (∀ (x : L), x ∈ t → 0 ≤ f x) → (∀ (x : L), x ∈ t → f x ≤ r) → (List.map (⇑f) t).prod ≤ r ^ t.length
items.informal_description: For any ordered commutative monoid with zero $ R $ where multiplication is monotonic for non-negative elements, given a function $ f $ mapping elements of a list $ t $ to $ R $, if each $ f(x) $ is non-negative and satisfies $ f(x) \leq r $ for some $ r \in R $, then the product of the mapped elements satisfies $ \prod_{x \in t} f(x) \leq r^{\lvert t \rvert} $, where $ \lvert t \rvert $ denotes the length of the list $ t $.

items.informal_name: Submultiplicative Function Inequality for Finite Products and Sums
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : CommMonoid α] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid β] [inst_2 : Preorder β]
  [AddLeftMono β] (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → α} (g : α → β),
  g 1 ≤ 0 → (∀ (a b : α), g (a * b) ≤ g a + g b) → g (∏ x ∈ s, f x) ≤ ∑ x ∈ s, g (f x)
items.informal_description: Let $\alpha$ be a multiplicative monoid and $M$ an ordered additive commutative monoid. For any function $g : \alpha \to M$ satisfying $g(1) \leq 0$ and $g(ab) \leq g(a) + g(b)$ for all $a, b \in \alpha$, and for any finite set $s$ and function $f : s \to \alpha$, it holds that $g\left(\prod_{x \in s} f(x)\right) \leq \sum_{x \in s} g(f(x))$.

items.informal_name: Exponential Inequality for List Product in Monoid
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_3} [inst : Monoid M] [inst_1 : Preorder M] [MulRightMono M] [MulLeftMono M] (l : List M) (n : M),
  (∀ (x : M), x ∈ l → n ≤ x) → n ^ l.length ≤ l.prod
items.informal_description: Let $ M $ be a monoid equipped with a preorder $ \leq $ where both left and right multiplication are order-preserving. For any list $ l $ of elements in $ M $ and any element $ n \in M $ such that $ n \leq x $ for all $ x \in l $, it holds that $ n^{|l|} \leq \prod_{x \in l} x $, where $ |l| $ denotes the length of the list $ l $.
